title: Soil, Root Zone, Transplant, Irrigation, and Mulch Workbook
purpose: Provide field-ready records for soil preparation, rooting systems, acclimation, irrigation uniformity, and soil-surface management.

sections.title: Field Soil Baseline
sections.decisionPrompt: What measured constraint should be corrected before planting?

sections.title: Rooting System Comparison
sections.decisionPrompt: Which rooting system best controls the site's limiting factors?

sections.title: Transplant and Acclimation Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Was transplant stress caused mainly by root handling, water status, light, wind, or temperature?

sections.title: Irrigation Uniformity and Scheduling Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is poor crop uniformity consistent with measured irrigation nonuniformity?

sections.title: Mulch and Cover-Crop Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the surface treatment delivering its intended benefit without adding a larger risk?

qualityRules: Use representative soil and irrigation samples.
Keep amendment, irrigation, and crop-response records linked by date and zone.
Do not infer root-zone status from surface appearance alone.
Record unintended pest, disease, salinity, and fire effects.
